issues.legal_issue: A civil suit may be transferred between states when transfer is necessary to serve the ends of justice, notwithstanding the plaintiff’s choice of forum.
material_facts: A defendant sought transfer of a defamation suit from the forum selected by the plaintiff to a forum in another state.
The suit concerned allegations about land transactions and official acts in Karnataka.

Most of the documentary evidence and the majority of witnesses were available in Karnataka, and requiring them to attend trial in Bombay would cause difficulty and expense and handicap the defendant’s defence.
The plaintiff ordinarily resided in Bangalore, the allegations had also been published there, and transfer would cause him no substantial prejudice.
issues.conclusion: The petition was allowed and the suit was transferred from the Bombay High Court to the City Civil Court, Bangalore, for trial and disposal in accordance with law.
issues.legal_principle: Section 25(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 empowers the Supreme Court to transfer a suit between states when satisfied that transfer is expedient for the ends of justice. That determination depends on the circumstances of each case, with the ends of justice as the paramount consideration. The plaintiff’s status as dominus litis and convenience considerations do not prevent transfer when justice requires it; convenience alone is not enough unless the circumstances show that trial in the chosen forum would impair justice. The Court relied on Sanjay Gandhi v. Rani Jethmalani, [1979] 2 SCR 378, and Union of India v. Shiromani Gurdwara Prabandhak Committee, [1986] 3 SCR 472.

rule.if: interstate_civil_suit_transfer_petition and most_evidence_and_witnesses_near_requested_forum and current_forum_hinders_defence and not substantial_prejudice_to_other_party

predicates.interstate_civil_suit_transfer_petition: A party sought transfer of a civil suit from a court in one state to a court in another state.
predicates.most_evidence_and_witnesses_near_request: Most documentary evidence and most witnesses relevant to the suit were available near the requested forum.
predicates.current_forum_hinders_defence: Trying the suit in the existing forum would make it difficult for the defendant to obtain evidence or witnesses and present the defence.
predicates.substantial_prejudice_to_other_party: The transfer would cause substantial prejudice to the other party.
predicates.civil_suit_transferred_to_forum_with_loc: The civil suit is transferred to the forum near the evidence and witnesses.

issues.definition: When a party seeks transfer of a civil suit between states, most evidence and witnesses are near the requested forum, the existing forum hinders the defence, and the other party would suffer no substantial prejudice, the suit is transferred to the forum near that evidence and those witnesses.
